description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'PHPFixCodingStandardsCommand' that extends Symfony's Command component. It provides functionality to run PHP CS Fixer to automatically fix code style issues across the project, with options for cache reset and PHP binary specification.

classes.name: PHPFixCodingStandardsCommand
classes.description: A console command for fixing PHP code standards using PHP CS Fixer within the project.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description, help message, and input options for the CLI command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the PHP CS Fixer process, optionally resets the cache, and displays the results or errors.
